    review_perspective: architecture_maintainability_and_reuse

    status: inspected_no_risk
    evidence: >-
      SKILL.md:70-76 and expert-method-design.md:11-38 connect source-backed
      cues to method selection, raw inputs, expected artifacts, limitations,
      uncertainty, and a noncircular wrong-outcome check. Lines 40-46 label
      the latency example as a hypothesis. Lines 50-63 preserve authority
      boundaries and qualify source support. Checked both cited primary pages.
  - scope_item_id: scope-guide
    applicable_concern: concern-conditionality
    review_perspective: architecture_maintainability_and_reuse
    coverage_obligation: validate-material-capability-trigger-and-exclusions
    status: inspected_no_risk
    evidence: >-
      Canonical and generated guide:14-22, SKILL.md:70-76,
      expert-method-design.md:3-7, and DESIGN SD10:77-80 consistently
      condition this work on new/material capability guidance requiring expert
      judgment. Mechanical and preference-only exceptions are explicit in
      human guidance. Existing DESIGN remains the owner; no universal research,
      case quota, new phase, authoring report, schema, or expert mode is added.

summary: >-
  No material findings within the reviewed scope and available evidence.
  The guidance specifies consequential decision methods rather than an expert
  persona, preserves applicability exceptions and authority boundaries, and
  distinguishes source plausibility from measured behavioral improvement.
  This verdict covers P-authoring only.

evidence:
  - source: /Users/laimis/.codex/skills/assistant-review/contracts/handoffs.yaml
    detail: >-
      Resolved the selected fresh_reviewer_context selector and recursively
      loaded orchestrator_to_reviewer.return_fields, including nested required

  - source: docs/plans/expert-method-pilot/impact/candidate-source-snapshot.json
    detail: >-
      Independently hashed all six source files and recomputed
      sha256:913570b34ed29499518ab84ba308ba76997092fd320d916bf10afcb1e14f76e7.
      Final source check after receiving canonical batch identifiers matched

  - source: docs/plans/expert-method-pilot/impact/source.diff
    detail: >-
      Inspected the complete six-file patch and actual affected instructions;
      compared method conditions with retained DESIGN and verification boundaries.
  - source: docs/plans/expert-method-pilot/plan.md
    detail: >-
      Approval scope selects source/semantic assessment of creator guidance,
      no new executable-test assertions, and no isolated claim of causal
      creator-method benefit.
  - source: skills/assistant-skill-creator/references/expert-method-design.md:58-63
    detail: >-
      Source rationale matches the inspected primary material:
      [Felix Rieseberg's article](https://felixrieseberg.com/how-to-be-more-ambitious-a-tutorial-for-humans-with-models/)
      motivates professional methods, raw evidence, and outside validation;
      [FRA Cognitive Task Analysis](https://railroads.dot.gov/human-factors/elearning-attention/cognitive-task-analysis)
      describes incident-based elicitation of expert judgments and cues.
      The adaptation explicitly limits these to motivation for an authoring hypothesis.
  - source: docs/plans/expert-method-pilot/impact/verification
    detail: >-
      Inspected recorded argv/cwd/exit results for V1, V3, V4-creator,
      V4-guide, aggregate-skills, aggregate-fixtures, and diff-check: all exit 0.
      Focused logs confirm creator validation, guide parity, semantic-contract
      suite completion, and guide synchronization checks. These support
      structural compatibility, not behavioral superiority.
  - source: /tmp/expert-pilot-review/batch-context.json
    detail: >-
      Read canonical identity fields only and confirmed the supplied
      batch/snapshot/round binding. No sibling outputs, held-out fixtures,
      or pilot-result assessment were inspected.

semantic_contract_checks:
  inherited_contract_obligations: >-
    No concrete risk found. Existing metadata, requires, operation permissions,
    approval gates, and consumed outputs remain intact; the new method adds no
    output envelope.
  template_contract_alignment: >-
    No concrete risk found. Root, reference, canonical guide, generated guide,
    load set, and SD10 use compatible method concepts and conditions.
  eval_inheritance_coverage: >-
    Pilot evaluation correctness and held-out coverage are outside this pass.
    Existing focused semantic-contract execution evidence was inspected;
    no new permanent automated assertions were selected.
  external_method_signature_fidelity: >-
    No concrete risk found. The sources motivate an explicitly qualified
    authoring hypothesis; the instructions do not claim to implement a complete
    named CTA protocol or establish best-expert equivalence.
  high_stakes_recommendation_guard: >-
    No concrete risk found. Reference:21-22 and 50-53 retain permission,
    access, read-only, metadata, dependency, and approval constraints, and
    explicitly prohibit installing tools or extending persistence for this method.
  mirror_surface_sync: >-
    Canonical and generated guide bytes match. Their provenance identifies
    the canonical producer and sync tool; carried parity and synchronization
    checks passed.

principle_checks:
  solid: >-
    No concrete risk found. Method derivation belongs to creator DESIGN;
    verification selection and evidence assessment retain their existing owner.
  kiss: >-
    No concrete risk found. Conditional loading uses one focused reference
    and the existing success criteria and DESIGN gate.
  dry: >-
    No concrete risk found. Existing verification outputs are reused.
    The intentional guide mirror has a canonical source, sync tool, and parity checks.
  yagni: >-
    No concrete risk found. No additional phase, state, report, schema,
    persona mode, quota, or tool dependency is introduced.
  readability: >-
    No concrete risk found. The cue-to-method chain, limitations, source
    distinctions, and concrete latency example make the requested reasoning recoverable.
  design_coherence: >-
    No concrete risk found. The affected unit is creator authoring guidance;
    its responsibility is deriving reusable expert decisions during DESIGN.
    Verification remains a separate existing responsibility, and source detail
    is progressively loaded. No hidden state or conflicting authority was found.

reuse_search:
  applicability: applicable
  applicability_reason: >-
    The change introduces rule-like authoring guidance and an evidence-check
    requirement that could duplicate existing framework responsibilities.
  searches:
    - query_or_path: "expert|cue.to.method|raw input|authoritative method|wrong.outcome|independent check"
      scope: "Creator references/contracts and assistant-verification instructions/references; excluded eval fixtures"
      outcome: >-
        Found existing wrong-outcome/evidence selection in assistant-verification
        and workflow-promotion requirements in verified-skill-distillation.
        No existing creator reference supplied this expert cue-to-method derivation.
    - query_or_path: "contract-design-checklist.md; verified-skill-distillation.md; canonical/generated design guide"
      scope: skills/assistant-skill-creator/references
      outcome: >-
        Inspected connected existing guidance to distinguish method derivation,
        verified lesson promotion, contract design, and portable guide duplication.
  candidates:
    - name: Existing verification selection and evidence assessment
      location: skills/assistant-verification/SKILL.md:19-35
      disposition: reuse
      rationale: >-
        The new reference reuses existing criteria and canonical verification
        outputs instead of creating an authoring-specific oracle schema.
    - name: Verified Skill Distillation
      location: skills/assistant-skill-creator/references/verified-skill-distillation.md:3-29
      disposition: reject_independent
      rationale: >-
        Governs promotion of completed workflow lessons. It does not replace
        derivation of expert decision methods during capability design;
        the existing promotion approval remains intact.
    - name: Portable design-guide mirror
      location: docs/skill-contract-design-guide.md:3-5
      disposition: intentional_duplicate
      rationale: >-
        Installed portability requires the local copy. Canonical provenance,
        the sync tool, equal hashes, and passing parity checks control divergence.
  decision: extend
  decision_rationale: >-
    Extend creator DESIGN with one focused method reference while reusing
    existing success criteria, verification ownership, promotion boundaries,
    and guide generation.

rubric_scores:
  correctness: 5.0
  code_quality: 5.0
  architecture: 5.0
  security: 5.0

    test_coverage: >-
